subject: Aurora evaluation playbook — decision chain & systems boundary
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@aurora-sys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T15:12:00Z
Subject: Aurora evaluation playbook — decision chain & systems boundary

Sam — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned heading into the security kickoff.

Call highlights (short):
- Economic buyer + contract lead: Mike Chen (procurement) — confirmed
- Legal & compliance: Hannah Liu (in-house counsel) — will own SOC2 / DPA review
- Technical owners: Rajesh (CTO) + SRE team (we’ll need a technical contact list)
- Primary decision criteria: data residency & controls, predictable latency for inference (95th < 200ms), and an auditable logs / retention posture for 12 months.

Scope assumptions to validate before the kickoff:
- Systems in scope: Prod inference cluster (customer-facing), staging (for validation), and the SSO / identity integration. Not in scope: internal analytics pipeline unless you flag otherwise.
- Data types: PII will be processed in a tokenized path — please confirm whether any PHI elements will be present.

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) I’ll send our security questionnaire (attached) for your team to fill — focus areas: network access, key management, logging/retention, and incident response.
2) Schedule a 60-min security kickoff with Hannah + Mike + Aurora technical stakeholders — week of May 3. We’ll include Marissa (solutions) and Neha (security PM).
3) Draft a short mutual action plan that maps deliverables and timelines (DocuSign link below).

Attachments: Aurora_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf (please review the items under encryption & access), MAM-Checklist-Aurora.xlsx (internal checklist mapping).

If anything above is incorrect or missing, flag it and I’ll update. Proposed kickoff times: Tue May 4 16:00 ET or Wed May 5 10:00 ET — what works best?

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Thanks, Jordan — great summary and yes, accurate on our side with a couple small clarifications.

Clarifications:
- Rajesh will loop in our Head of Platform (Leah Wong) and the SRE lead (Tomás Rivera) to the kickoff — they’ll own the technical validation.
- PHI: currently no PHI expected for this integration — primarily account data and telemetry. We’ll confirm in writing during the questionnaire.
- Data residency: we require inference processing to occur in us-east-1 for initial rollout; long term we may add eu-central.

Kickoff: Wed May 5 10:00 ET works for our team. Please send dial-in + agenda.

I’m attaching our high-level network diagram (Aurora_Technical_Boundary_DIagram.png) — it shows the edge gateways and where tokens are masked.

On the questionnaire: can you call out any fields that would trigger a non-starter (e.g., if Redwood requires broad log ingestion we may need to scope that differently)?

Sam

Jordan / Neha — I read the diagram Sam attached and the questionnaire draft. A few practical notes for the kickoff so we come prepared:

Technical scope (we should confirm these explicitly at kickoff):
- In-scope systems: prod inference endpoints, staging environment for model validation, SSO (Okta tenant), and metrics export (Prometheus/Stackdriver).
- Network/access controls we’ll ask for: CIDR allowlist for egress where needed, VPN or peering for secure data flows, and a read-only service account for logs ingestion if required.
- Keys: we support customer KMS/HSM integrations — ask them to indicate whether they require CMKs in their tenant.

Security review logistics:
- Pre-kickoff ask: ask Aurora to complete pages 1–3 of the questionnaire (basic infra + access controls) — that’ll let Neha triage what needs deeper evidence (SOC2 reports, key rotation policies, pen-test reports).
- Evidence: if they want us to produce artifacts (e.g., sample audit logs), we’ll include a time estimate in the mutual action plan.

I’ll draft a kickoff agenda: 1) Introductions & goals, 2) Decision criteria validation, 3) Systems-in-scope walkthrough (Sam’s diagram), 4) Evidence/next steps mapping.

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
